description: LAX has four parallel east-west runways on two pairs: north (06L/24R, 06R/24L) and south (07L/25R, 07R/25L). Headings are TRUE: US coded METAR/ASOS wind is referenced to true north (spoken ATIS/tower wind is magnetic instead) -- the OPPOSITE of the naive assumption, confirmed via secondary sources quoting the AIM/NWS ASOS docs, see research doc section 3. Not checked against the FAA Chart Supplement. Surprising, twice-corroborated finding: AirNav and SkyVector both give the SAME heading (083T/071M and 263T/251M) for all four runways -- the 06-side and 07-side pairs aren't distinguishable in current data despite different numbers; unresolved, see research doc section 2.
source: AirNav (FAA data effective 30-10-2025) and SkyVector, cross-checked, 31-10-2026. Not checked against the FAA Chart Supplement/AIP.
